acceptanceCriteria: Both adapters pass a regression whose leader dies on TERM while a same-group descendant ignores TERM and closes stdin/stdout/stderr.
After timeout and explicit cancellation, no descendant remains and completion does not race ahead of the final cleanup check.
Normal leader exit with a surviving same-group descendant cannot silently leave owned work behind.
Retain current host deadline and visible FALLBACK behavior; cleanup failure is distinguished from successful cleanup.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, AGENT-01. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

A bounded Corvint invocation owns a descendant that ignores SIGTERM and closes inherited stdio. On timeout the leader exits, its close event cancels the pending SIGKILL, and the adapter returns a FALLBACK timeout while that descendant remains alive. Repeated lifecycle timeouts can accumulate orphan work. This is reproduced on both shipped JavaScript adapters; it does not require the descendant to escape its process group.

Source: integrations/opencode/src/runtime.js:422; integrations/opencode/src/runtime.js:475; integrations/gemini-cli/hooks/corvint-hook.mjs:392; integrations/testfixture/main.go:59; integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs:233

Owning contract/status: "AHI-008 host sandbox/process ownership; AHI-009/012 bounded fail-open degradation; AHI acceptance case 7 (timeout); existing named 'timeout leaves no descendant' and 'interruption leaves no descendant' adapter regressions. AHI-024 explicitly requires this property for Pi, but is not used to claim a Pi failure here."

Verification: ["node /tmp/corvint-audit-20260926/agents-cleanup-repro.mjs: OpenCode returned timeout/deadlineMs=700 and Gemini returned corvint-timeout; both descendants remained alive 200 ms after return. Full outputs retained in agents-cleanup-repro.jsonl.", "Scratch reproduction finally blocks killed both descendants; subsequent kill(pid,0) returned ESRCH for both. No owned processes remain."]

Suggested correction: Retain group ownership after leader exit. Complete TERM/KILL escalation and check group disappearance before resolving, with bounded cleanup-failed/unconfirmed fallback where cleanup cannot be proved. Do not clear the forced-kill timer merely because leader stdio closes. Reuse the stronger existing Pi or native supervisor design where practical.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
title: OpenCode and Gemini cancel descendant cleanup when the process leader closes
